decisions.decision: Organisation managers are follow-only; the site team creates accounts, sets the organisation field and enrols organisations
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-01: core cannot scope cohort assignment, manual enrolment, locked-field edits or account creation to one organisation
decisions.rejected: Manager self-service through our own local_ltuse page and web service

decisions.decision: Organisation, managers and country cohorts are system-level and hidden
decisions.why: cohort_get_available_cohorts offers a course only cohorts from its parent contexts; hidden system cohorts are visible only with system cohort:view
decisions.rejected: Category cohorts per organisation, which cannot reach shared curriculum courses

decisions.decision: Separation inside shared courses is separate groups (default, not forced), with one group per organisation via cohort sync
decisions.why: Core separates people within a course by group; not forcing keeps cross-organisation forums possible
decisions.rejected: Forced separate groups, or separate course copies per organisation

decisions.decision: orgmanager role assigned through a managers-cohort sync instance, course context only, no prohibits
decisions.why: One step makes someone a manager everywhere their organisation is enrolled; no prohibit keeps mentor permissions intact
decisions.rejected: Role assignment at the organisation category

decisions.decision: tool_dynamic_cohorts fills cohorts, via its persistent-class API, gated on 5.2 verification
decisions.why: Maintained, free, rules creatable without direct table writes
decisions.rejected: local_profilecohort (official 5.2 support but no rule API; kept as fallback) and our own observer

decisions.decision: The organisation profile field stores the stable key; expertise is one checkbox per competencies.yaml category; country is the core field
decisions.why: Renames change no learner data; core has no multi-select; core country already exists
decisions.rejected: Display name as stored value; a custom country menu

decisions.decision: A local_ltuse control_view_profile hook refuses org managers the profile of anyone outside their organisations; cohort sync uses unenrolaction 3
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-01: core keeps a suspended enrolment and its group, so groups cannot tell former members from current ones
decisions.rejected: Unenrol on leaving (loses history); accepting the gap

decisions.decision: Category pages and course names stay public; separation covers people only
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-01: course names hold no personal data and come from the public repo

decisions.decision: A moved learner on a shared-course participants list is a documented known limit, closed by a manual site-team unenrol of the stale suspended enrolment
decisions.why: User decision 2026-10-01: no more own code; unenrolling a non-last enrolment keeps history
decisions.rejected: An observer that unenrols the stale enrolment automatically

decisions.decision: Category adoption also takes a same-name category whose idnumber is not ltct:
decisions.why: The build host's LTC Pilots and LTC Published carried hand-set idnumbers; the empty-only rule would have created duplicates

decisions.decision: orgmanager deny list adds moodle/course:managegroups and moodle/course:viewsuspendedusers
decisions.why: Either would let a manager reach another organisation's people or moved learners

decisions.decision: tool_dynamic_cohorts/releasemembers pinned to 0 and realtime to 1 in settings/cohorts.yaml
decisions.why: At 1, unmanaging a cohort deletes all members without events

decisions.decision: local_ltuse bumped to 2026100102 with the new lib.php
decisions.why: The callback then arrives through a normal upgrade, not only a cache purge
Creating orgmanager (role id 10) surfaced it, exactly like map_9 for ltcpublisher
decisions.rejected: A pattern-based ignore, which would change spec 001's contract

decisions.decision: Superseded 2026-10-02 (open courses): managers are not follow-only, and shared courses have no organisation groups; see spec.md Clarifications
Managers can no longer be hidden from: managers_see_identity cut by the spec 016 scope review (Doug, 2026-10-05)
FR-014 to FR-019 and SC-006 stay deferred to a later plan step (Doug, 2026-10-05)
mentors.php can_view_identity ask dropped as moot (Doug, 2026-10-05)

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and declaration contract for organisations, cohorts, profile fields and the orgmanager role
plan.key_finding: Moodle categories separate courses, not people: org separation must come from hidden system cohorts plus separate groups, and manager self-service needs own code

tasks.summary: 37 tasks: Setup 3, Foundational 16, US1 1, US2 9 including the profile hook, US3 1, US4 1, Polish 7; three adversarial review rounds applied
tasks.key_finding: Core keeps suspended enrolments and their groups, so people who leave an organisation stay visible to its manager unless a profile hook and a manual unenrol close the gap

implement.summary: Spec 002 built and verified on ltuse.net: 4 organisations with categories, cohorts and auto-fill rules; profile fields; orgmanager role; profile hook; all 38 tasks done

approach: Declare organisations and profile fields under moodle/site/ and extend spec 001's applier with categories, cohorts, profile fields and tool_dynamic_cohorts rules. Separate organisations by hidden system cohorts and per-organisation groups in separate-groups courses, with a follow-only orgmanager role arriving through a managers-cohort sync.

FR-001.title: The repo declares the partner organisations, each with a stable key and display name, applied through spec 001

FR-002.title: Each organisation gets one course category, one organisation cohort and one managers cohort, created only if absent

FR-003.title: The published curriculum lives in a shared category; organisation categories hold organisation-specific courses

FR-004.title: Removing an organisation deletes nothing; drift reports it

FR-005.title: Exactly one organisation manager role, declared in the repo, for every partner

FR-006.title: A manager sees and opens their own learners in every course their organisation is enrolled in; the site team enrols

FR-007.title: A manager cannot view, find, enrol or edit another organisation's learners or cohorts, including people who left

FR-008.title: Profile fields for organisation, country, role in the work and expertise, each with a declared visibility

FR-009.title: The organisation field is editable only by the site team

FR-010.title: Learners join and leave organisation and country cohorts automatically from profile fields

FR-011.title: Courses support groups, so an organisation can be worked with separately in a shared course

FR-012.title: Manager assignment happens in Moodle, never by recording the person in the repo

FR-013.title: Only the site team creates learner accounts
